task: Add an in-memory command-log record store as a new Rust module (cmdlog.rs) with open/append/close/list/get-by-id commands, wired into AppState and Tauri registration, no frontend wiring in this slice.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components — the new cmdlog.rs command module and an AppState extension — across the command layer and the state layer, but the pattern is fully established: runner.rs/pty.rs/logger.rs are direct siblings, and the architecture guide's explicit 'Adding New System Commands' checklist covers this exact shape.

Record fields (id, command, exit code, start time, duration, raw output) and the five operations (open/append/close/list/get-by-id) are named explicitly; the one open detail is the internal storage shape (Vec vs HashMap, id-generation scheme), a minor implementation choice not an unresolved requirement.
